headline: Sammaan Capital makes timely interest payment on secured redeemable NCDs
hook: Timely debt servicing by Sammaan Capital
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified that it made timely interest payments for its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 57 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. Such compliance filings assure debenture holders of regular debt servicing. Retail investors holding these NCDs receive predictable fixed income without default risks.
why_it_matters: Debenture holders receive scheduled interest without delay.

headline: Sammaan Capital makes timely interest payment on non-convertible debentures
hook: Timely debt servicing by Sammaan Capital
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified that it made a timely interest payment on its publicly issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 57 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. This routine regulatory filing confirms the company's compliance with debt servicing obligations.
why_it_matters: Debenture holders receive timely interest payments as scheduled.

headline: Sammaan Capital Q2 disbursements grow 55% QoQ
summary: Sammaan Capital reported a nearly 55% quarter-on-quarter increase in disbursements for the September quarter. Following the announcement, the stock jumped 5% in intraday trade. Brokerage firm Ventura Securities maintains a 'Buy' rating on the stock with a target price of Rs 377.70 per share. Retail investors can view this as a sign of business momentum recovery, directly impacting the stock's near-term price action.
why_it_matters: Disbursal growth signals improving credit momentum for the company.
winners_losers: Sammaan Capital shareholders gain / none hurt

headline: Sammaan Capital reports Q2 FY27 disbursements of Rs 6,000 crore and AUM exceeding Rs 59,000 crore
hook: Disbursements jump 55 percent at Sammaan Capital
summary: Sammaan Capital announced provisional Q2 FY27 disbursements of approximately Rs 6,000 crore, up from Rs 3,875 crore in Q1 FY27. Assets Under Management grew to over Rs 59,000 crore as of September 30, 2026, compared to Rs 56,239 crore at the end of June. The company added over 30,700 new customers during the quarter and expanded its branch network to 245. This data is provisional and subject to statutory audit review.
whats_next: Audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
why_it_matters: Stronger loan growth signals improving momentum for Sammaan Capital

headline: Sammaan Capital makes timely interest payment on secured NCDs
hook: Timely debt service by Sammaan Capital
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified that it made timely interest payments on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued through a public issue and listed on stock exchanges. The disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 57 of SEBI Listing Regulations. This procedural filing confirms debt servicing by the company. Retail bondholders receive their scheduled interest payouts on time.
why_it_matters: Scheduled bond interest credited to eligible debenture holders.

headline: Sammaan Capital appoints P.S. Negi as LIC Nominee Director
hook: LIC places nominee on Sammaan board
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has announced the appointment of P.S. Negi as a LIC Nominee Director on its board, effective September 30, 2026. LIC holds a stake in the company, warranting board representation. The appointment brings institutional oversight from a major domestic investor into the governance of the financial services firm. Indian retail shareholders gain direct visibility into institutional monitoring of the company's management and strategy.
whats_next: Board changes take effect on September 30, 2026.
why_it_matters: Institutional oversight increases for your investment.

headline: Sammaan Capital submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine filings from the annual meet
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company submitted the voting results alongside the scrutinizer's report as part of routine compliance. These filings record shareholder approvals on resolutions tabled during the AGM. Retail investors should note this is standard corporate procedure with no direct impact on immediate share price movement.
why_it_matters: Standard AGM compliance update with no financial impact.
